from cyhole.jupiter import Jupiter
from cyhole.jupiter.client import GetSwapOrderParams, PostSwapExecuteBody

# Initialize Jupiter client
jupiter = Jupiter()
client = jupiter.client

# SOL mint address: So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112
# USDC mint address: EPjFWaJB6q9c6kNQZ7fVi5QCFhZSJJFdL3xFr7Jzqpq

# Request swap order (quote)
swap_order_params = GetSwapOrderParams(
    input_mint="So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",  # SOL
    output_mint="EPjFWaJB6q9c6kNQZ7fVi5QCFhZSJJFdL3xFr7Jzqpq",  # USDC
    amount=1000000000,  # 1 SOL in lamports
)

swap_order_response = client.get_swap_order(swap_order_params)

# Build swap transaction
swap_build_params = swap_order_response  # Use the order response to build
swap_build_response = client.get_swap_build(swap_order_response)

# Execute swap
execute_body = PostSwapExecuteBody(
    swap_response=swap_build_response,
)

swap_execute_response = client.post_swap_execute(execute_body)

print("Swap executed successfully!")
print(f"Transaction signature: {swap_execute_response}")
